outcome.Summary: Extended the config package: added `Timeout` (env APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s) and `Tags` (env APP_TAGS, comma-separated, trimmed, empties dropped, default nil) fields; added `Merge(base, override Config)` which replaces base's fields with any non-zero override values (a non-nil override Tags slice replaces base's even when empty, without mutating either argument's slice); and reworked `Load` to collect all invalid env values and return them joined via `errors.Join` (returning the zero Config), keeping all existing field behaviour. Added tests covering new-field defaults, tag parsing, multi-error collection (each variable name present, 4 joined errors, zero Config returned), and Merge semantics; `go build`, `go vet`, `gofmt` and `go test ./...` all pass.
